text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens from Belt and Road countries and hold a valid ordinary passport. 2. Applicants for bachelor degree must be no more than 25 years old; applicants for master degree must be no more than 35 years old. 3. Applicants for bachelor degree should have a high school diploma or equivalent qualifications, with excellent academic performance; applicants for master’s degree should have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualifications, with excellent academic performance. 5. Applicants must be in good health. 6. Applicants must have no violation of discipline, no public security punishment, no criminal behavior or record, friendly to China, have good conduct, abide by Chinese laws and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese people's customs and habits. 7. Meet other requirements specified in the International Student Enrollment Manual of Beijing International Studies University.
